thread:
Ava S.: FYI customer SUP-4721 reporting p99 spikes ~8-12s on Dedicated pool eu-west-2-prod for short gens (200-400 tokens). Started ~09:10Z. They see attach delays + cold gpu logs. Escalating to oncall and eng-sre.

Jordan (oncall): I'm on it. Alerts show 40 attach timeouts in last 15m, p99 > 5s. Spotted a sharp warm-instance drop earlier. Routing to eng-sre and infra for triage.

alerts-bot: ALERT: dedicated-pool eu-west-2-prod p99 latency threshold breached (5m average). Recent metric: attach_timeouts=40 (15m). Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALERT-8892

Samir K.: Pulled attach-controller and gpu-agent logs. Sequence: scale request -> VM provisioning -> VM boots -> gpu-agent init 12-20s -> runtime handshake sometimes retries -> attach completes ~20-35s. That lines up with cold GPU starts + agent init slowness.

Devon L.: Adding context: warm pool count decayed from ~24 down to 5 across last 3.5h due to aggressive scale-down policy (cooldown=10m, min_warm=4). Then a small burst caused many parallel scale-ups and we saw queueing. p95 mostly OK, p99 blows up. Seems autoscaler policy + cold start behavior compounding.

Lucia M.: Customer repro they provided: short burst (peak ~200qps for ~40s) then p99 jumps. They captured a trace with attach logs: 
```
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z INF attach-request id=xyz789 pool=eu-west-2-prod
2026-03-15T09:10:14Z WRN attach-queue len=22
2026-03-15T09:10:19Z ERR gpu-agent init-timeout
2026-03-15T09:10:33Z INF attach-success id=xyz789 backend=dedicated-12
```

Ava S.: Customer asking for immediate mitigation and ETA for a permanent fix. We should give an interim plan and roadmap.

Jordan (oncall): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) bump pool min_warm from 4 -> 10; 2) increase autoscaler cooldown to 30m temporarily; 3) enable hosted fallback routing for this customer if latency stays >3s. Which to execute now?

Samir K.: Do min_warm bump first. Also I can roll a prewarm init flag in attach-controller that runs a lightweight CUDA init before marking instance warm — reduces agent init by ~6-8s in tests.

Devon L.: I'll pause aggressive scale-down (set autoscaler target util lower so controller keeps more warm nodes) and set cooldown 30m. That should reduce oscillation.

Lucia M.: Draft customer message for approval: "We've temporarily increased reserved warm capacity for your Dedicated pool and adjusted autoscale settings. This will keep p99 within acceptable range while we implement a permanent fix. We may also route a small fraction of traffic to our hosted fallback for short windows if needed. No model or data changes were made." Approve?

Ava S.: Looks fine. Jordan, coordinate the changes and notify customer once you see improvement. Also open an internal RCA ticket for long-term work.

Jordan (oncall): Executing mitigations now. Commands for audit: 
```
curl -X PATCH https://infra-api/pools/eu-west-2-prod -d '{"min_warm":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**'
./autoscalerctl set --pool eu-west-2-prod --cooldown 1800
kubectl set env deployment/attach-controller PREWARM_INIT=true -n infra
```
deploy-bot: rollout started for attach-controller env change. rollout/attach-controller: 1/3 pods updated

Samir K.: After bump, warm instances increased from 5 -> 11 over ~5m. Attach timeouts dropped from 40 -> 5 in 12m. Customer reports p99 down to ~2.3s from ~9.8s baseline. Improvement but not yet at SLA.

alerts-bot: NOTE: attach_timeouts decreased 87% after config changes. Monitoring for 30m.

Devon L.: Longer-term recommendations: 1) per-customer sticky warm reservations for high-SLA tenants; 2) gpu-agent fast-init kernel to halve init time (work with runtime and infra); 3) predictive warm-up (burst detector based on rate-of-change of request rate); 4) surge buffer capacity for business-critical pools. I'll write RFCs.

Ava S.: Capture metrics for postmortem: p50/p95/p99, attach_time histogram, warm_pool counts before/after. Samir, paste the windows.

Samir K.: Metrics snapshot (10m windows): 
- 09:00-09:10 p99=0.7s attach_median=0.8s warm_pool=22
- 09:10-09:20 p99=9.8s attach_median=2.5s warm_pool=5
- 09:20-09:30 p99=2.3s attach_median=1.1s warm_pool=11 (after mitigations)
Graphs: https://internal.redwood/metrics/graphs/SUP-4721

Lucia M.: Customer response: "Saw latency drop after you changed pool settings. Please share ETA on permanent fix and keep us posted."

Jordan (oncall): ETA: prewarm hook + agent init optimization prototype in 2 sprints (4 weeks), full agent fast-init kernel + rollout 6-8 weeks, predictive warm-up RFC 3-4 sprints. We'll include roadmap in postmortem.

Ava S.: Owners: Samir -> agent init perf and prototype; Devon -> autoscaler policy RFC and policy guardrails; Lucia -> customer comms & postmortem write-up; Jordan -> incident owner + dashboard. I'll follow up weekly.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-4721 updated: priority=high, status=in_progress, owner=Jordan (oncall)

Jordan (oncall): Closing thread for now. Will reopen if p99 > 3s or attach_timeouts spike. Thanks all :thumbsup:
